podcast.body: This single reached number one in the UK charts, leading to a celebration party where Damon Albarn of Blur attempted to offer congratulations, but was met with bragging from Liam Gallagher. "Later, when there was a party for Oasis when the single Some Might Say reached number one, Blur's Damon Albarn went so he could congratulate them."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was released as a CD single from the album "(What's the Story) Morning Glory?" The CD single included three extra songs, one of which was "Acquiesce." Oasis's CD singles were highly sought after due to the quality of their bonus tracks. "This was one of 3 extra songs that came on the CD single for some might say from the What's the story Morning glory out?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Digital Debris Part 1: B-Sides and Bonus Tracks

podcast.body: This song was the first single released from the "What's the Story Morning Glory" album. It serves as a prime example of Noel Gallagher's prolific songwriting, where even the A-sides were exceptional, and Noel was committed to its release as a single. "The hit with this CD single was Some Might Say, the first single from the What's the Story Morning glory album, and it's a great example of how Noll had so many great songs even the B-sides and bonus tracks were better than most band singles."
